Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 24  
Reason for Mistake: At step 24, WebSurfer incorrectly treated the Netflix search result for “Lara Croft: Tomb Raider” as if it were relevant to the query, even though the page snippet clearly showed the Netflix title as being on the Indian Netflix domain (“netflix.com/in/title”) and not Netflix US. This is a geographic availability mismatch. Since the task specifically asked for availability on Netflix (US), using non-US Netflix evidence could lead to the wrong conclusion.
